definitions.explanation: Used to describe fresh, perishable food products, particularly produce, meat, and seafood.

examples.japanese: {生鮮|せいせん}⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I shop in the fresh food section.

examples.japanese: {生鮮|せいせん}⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Fresh vegetables should be eaten quickly.

examples.japanese: {生鮮|せいせん}⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought fish at the fresh food market.

notes:
{生鮮|せいせん} is a no-adjective meaning fresh, specifically for perishable food products.

FORMS:
{生|せい} (raw, fresh) + {鮮|せん} (fresh, vivid) = fresh (food)

COMMON PATTERNS:
Used as no-adjective before nouns: {生鮮|せいせん}⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧ (fresh food)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生鮮|せいせん}⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧: fresh food, perishables
- {生鮮|せいせん}⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧: fresh vegetables
- {生鮮|せいせん}⟦{魚介|ぎょかい}→魚介：14708_gyokai⟧: fresh seafood
- {生鮮|せいせん}⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧: fresh meat
- {生鮮|せいせん}⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧: fresh food market
- {生鮮|せいせん}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧/⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: fresh food section

SUPERMARKET SECTIONS:
- {生鮮|せいせん}⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧: fresh section (vegetables, meat, fish)
- ⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧: processed foods
- ⟦{冷凍|れいとう}→冷凍：11730_reitou⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧: frozen foods
- ⟦{日配|にっぱい}{品|ひん}→日配品：noentry⟧: daily delivered items (dairy, bread)

USAGE:
{生鮮|せいせん} specifically refers to perishable freshness (needing refrigeration), while ⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧ is broader "freshness" including experiences and ideas.
